purpose: Identify evidence needed before the new-apartment inflation-only exception is treated as established.

required_evidence.why: RTB guidance says the landlord should have a commencement notice or 7-day notice submitted to a building control authority on or after 10 June 2025.
The current RTB rent-review form checklist identifies the related certificate of compliance upon completion as evidence that may be requested in an RTB investigation or dispute.
The legal test concerns specified construction, qualifying floor-area extension or qualifying change-of-use work.

decision_logic.verified_yes: Evidence supports the statutory conditions; proceed to full composition.
decision_logic.verified_no: Evidence establishes that the conditions are not met; do not apply this exception.
decision_logic.unknown: Do not assume the exception. Request or verify the missing evidence.
decision_logic.conflict: Conflicting evidence requires review before a definitive result.

official_sources: RTB Notice of Rent Review form
scope_limit: Evidence requirements are not themselves proof that an individual tenancy qualifies; the underlying statutory conditions must still be composed and verified.
